##### Project general facts

Experience the epitome of contemporary sophistication at NAS 3 in Arjan, a meticulously crafted development by Rabdan Developments featuring a luxurious range of studios to 3-bedroom apartments, each equipped with a private pool. This architectural marvel redefines modern elegance and refined living, showcasing a stunning design across its 12 floors and offering a carefully curated selection of 284 residences.

Going beyond the ordinary, the development provides facilities and amenities tailored to elevate lifestyles. Each unit boasts a swimming pool and balcony, with duplex options available for 2BHK apartments. A state-of-the-art gymnasium, spa, and well-manicured communal spaces offer residents opportunities for recreation and relaxation. The luxury-class façade combines elegance, comfort, and convenience, presenting a future home in Arjan's finest development. With an unwavering commitment to excellence, the developer continues to redefine luxury living, standing as a testament to architectural brilliance and innovation.

The well-thought-out configurations of the apartments redefine elevated living, featuring balconies that seamlessly merge indoor comfort with outdoor serenity. What distinguishes this development is the inclusion of a pool within each apartment, adding an exclusive touch to the living experience. With meticulous attention to detail, NAS 3 captivates residents and offers a glimpse into the pinnacle of luxury living.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a residential community located near the popular attractions of Dubai, such as the Dubai Miracle Garden and the Mall of the Emirates.

Arjan offers various amenities to its residents, including landscaped gardens, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail outlets. It is a family-friendly community with a safe and secure environment. There are several schools, healthcare facilities, and supermarkets in the area, making it a convenient place to live.

The community also features several parks and playgrounds, providing residents with opportunities for outdoor activities and recreational opportunities. Arjan is well-connected to the rest of Dubai through the Dubai-Al Ain Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and the Al Khail Road, making it easy to access other parts of the city.
